briefing.text: On the last complete day (Nov 13), Information Technology stayed the top sector on all three platforms. On News its buzz was 86.4 (down 1.5 on the day, up 2.9 on the week) with mentions down 24% and sentiment -0.04, led by NVDA, MSFT and AMD. On Reddit buzz was 94.7 (down 0.5, up 1.7 on the week) with mentions down 37% and sentiment -0.03; on X buzz was 93.5 (up 0.2) with mentions up 25% and sentiment 0.11. Utilities were the biggest riser on X (mentions up 209%, buzz 83.4, VST, CEG) and on Reddit (mentions up 123%, buzz 73.1, RWE, VST); Real Estate mentions rose 148% on X (OPEN, FRMI). On News, Financials fell from rank 2 to 9 (buzz down 6.5 on the day but up 14.2 on the week; BAC, UBS, MS) and Materials mentions dropped 30%.

NVDA #1: heavy coverage (1,199 articles in 2 days, 270 negative vs 139 positive) on AI-trade concentration; it fits the high attention, with earnings due 11-17.
UAL #2: headlines on a nationwide FAA ground stop on Friday night and a $30.1B airport funding request; this explains the jump from rank 40.
AAL #3: same FAA ground stop (airline stocks fell) plus a cancelled Delhi flight; explains the move up from rank 196.
BTI #4: only a TR-1 major-holdings notice from Capital Group; it does not explain the ranking.
KLAR #5: headlines say shares are surging, in line with the 8.7% one-day gain; earnings 11-17.
HOUSING #6: one article about a homebuilder ETF; no real news explanation.
KDP #8: coverage of a 38% run and a $2B equity raise, which fits the high volume.
TTWO #17: Grand Theft Auto VI launches Nov. 19, which explains the attention.

NVDA ranks first on strong attention (1.2x normal, 99th percentile) and volume (97th percentile), with earnings on 11-17 as the catalyst, even though the price is down 12.8% over 5 days. UAL (up from 40) is driven by attention (1.2x normal) and X attention (1.27x), helped by a Kalshi market with $42.6K of 24h volume, and the AAL ranking (up from 196) has the same pattern with X attention at 1.29x. Momentum is small for both: price moves are under 0.5 sigma and volume is below normal.

notes: Ranks are by the scoring of record (pick_rank, w2). Prices and moves as of the last pull of the day. Facts from public data; not investment advice.
